body.name: Worked fork covariance collision \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{fork}}(T)\)
body.construction: For \(p=2\), \(q=4\), and \(T>0\), \(T\ne1\), set the true baseline loading and variances to \(A=\begin{psmallmatrix}1&2&7&4\\2&3&11&7\end{psmallmatrix}\) and \(v=(1,1,1,1)\); set \(\Lambda^{(0)}_{21}=\Lambda^{(0)}_{31}=\Lambda^{(0)}_{32}=\Lambda^{(0)}_{42}=1\), \(h_1=0\), \(h_2=(1,0,0,0)\), \(h_3=(3,1,0,0)\), \(h_4=(1,1,0,0)\), and \(t=(4,4,T,4)\), with \(F=A(I_4-\Lambda^{(0)})\). For the candidate set \(\Lambda'^{(0)}_{21}=4\), \(\Lambda'^{(0)}_{32}=\Lambda'^{(0)}_{42}=1\), \(F'=\begin{psmallmatrix}-7&-9&7&4\\-10&-15&11&7\end{psmallmatrix}\), \(v'=(1,1,1,1)\), \(h'_1=0\), \(h'_2=(1,0,0,0)\), \(h'_3=(32/11,8/11,0,0)\), \(h'_4=(-2,-1/2,0,0)\), and \(t'=(4,4,T+144/121,19/4)\). In both models define each change row by \(\delta_k^{\mathsf T}=h_k^{\mathsf T}(I_4-\Lambda^{(0)})\) and its primed analogue, and use independent centered non-Gaussian errors with the displayed variances.
